name: 5-MeO-MALT
summary: A new and uncommon psychedelic tryptamine related to 5-MeO-DALT. Little is known about the drug, however its effects are likely similar to other psychedelic tryptamines.
advisory: There are inconsistent reports on the drugs effects. It is recommended to start low and raise dosages slowly.
doseBasis: NOTE: There are inconsistent reports on the drugs effects. It is recommended to start low and raise dosages slowly.

pharmacology.text: The pharmacology of 5-MeO-MALT has been studied. It is a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and produces the head-twitch response in rodents. The drug also shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug in 2014. The drug's pharmacology was studied and described in greater detail in 2024.
